name: offhours_universe_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: OFFHOURS_UNIVERSE_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1264 AMENDMENT 1. The Schwab off-hours lane's universe now comes
from config: the two file lists plus three READ-ONLY SQL sources (positions_current, trade_closed losses in the
last 30 days, active watchlist), so a held, stopped-out or watched name is fetched instead of reading 'now —'.
The window gained the Friday 16:00-20:00 after-hours segment its main span never covered. session_now words the
one 'now' line (session + time + price + change) and the next-open sentence, and market_quote.get_price_batch takes
the newer of market_quotes and market_quotes_extended. The emulation test in
tests/test_news_risk_raise_emulation_20261108.py renders a synthetic Friday 19:58 ET V print on a throwaway
socket-only Postgres cluster, never the live database.
